haberler.ozet_en: According to a report by Ma'ariv, there are concerns that attempts could be made in Israel to prevent the swearing-in ceremony of the 26th Knesset members and to replace Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana. Former senior security officials warned that events could unfold in a manner similar to the US Capitol riot. It was also claimed that about 1,500 right-wing activists, including armed individuals, could come to parliament.
